attackers_goals: Adversary may attempt to extract credentials from the Windows Registry Credentials can then be used to perform lateral movement and access restricted information.
description: A sensitive registry hive was extracted, which is used for accessing credentials.
investigative_actions: Investigate the process that tried to access the registry hive. Investigate the actions of the user for which his credentials were stored in the registry hive.

required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
